ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity dark pigment with a calculated high-intensity pixel ratio of approximately 8-12%, primarily attributed to barnacles and focal scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark grey/black ground across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters located at both distal lobe tips. Secondary distribution of isolated white circular nodes in the central-left and lower-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees and a narrow, well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern across 70% of the trailing edge, with notable peaks (amplitude 10-20 pixels) concentrated on the inner halves of both lobes flanking the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower boundary transitioning to a moderately concave sweep along the trailing edge, terminating in sharp upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-contrast white pixel rosettes corresponding to barnacle colonization on both terminal lobe tips. Isolated white circular scars are visible in the right lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct vertical high-contrast linear marks localized at the peduncle-fluke junction directly below the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters on the distal margins of both fluke lobes and visible vertical scarring at the base of the central notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent isolated white circular mark located in the right lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the distal tip.
